title: Audit the Windows Defender state across the domain
description: Check the Windows Defender state (protection on or off) on every computer of the domain through remote queries.

windowsCommandTemplate.name: Get-ADComputer
windowsCommandTemplate.commandPattern: $report = @(); Get-ADComputer -Filter {Enabled -eq $true} | ForEach-Object { try { $status = Invoke-Command -ComputerName $_.Name -ScriptBlock { Get-MpComputerStatus | Select-Object RealTimeProtectionEnabled,AntivirusSignatureLastUpdated } -ErrorAction Stop; $report += [PSCustomObject]@{ Computer=$_.Name; RealtimeProtection=$status.RealTimeProtectionEnabled; LastUpdate=$status.AntivirusSignatureLastUpdated; Status='Online' } } catch { $report += [PSCustomObject]@{ Computer=$_.Name; RealtimeProtection='N/A'; LastUpdate='N/A'; Status='Offline/Error' } } }; $report | Format-Table -AutoSize

examples.description: Show every property of the first object returned. Select-Object * widens the output to every column. -First 1 keeps the first result only. Use it to discover the available properties before filtering.
Export the results to a CSV file that Excel can open. -NoTypeInformation drops the metadata line. -Encoding UTF8 keeps accented characters intact. Useful for archiving, reports and external analysis.
Count the objects returned. Measure-Object returns Count, Sum, Average, Min and Max depending on the properties. Useful for quick statistics and to validate results.

notes: ⚠️ PERFORMANCE: on large domains this command takes time (remote queries). To speed it up, limit it to one OU with -SearchBase. Requires: WinRM enabled, administrator rights on the target machines. Offline/Error: PC turned off, WinRM disabled, firewall blocking. COMPLIANCE: 100% real-time protection is mandatory!

fr.title: Auditer l'état de Windows Defender sur tout le domaine
fr.description: Vérifie l'état de Windows Defender (protection active/inactive) sur tous les ordinateurs du domaine via requêtes à distance.
fr.notes: ⚠️ PERFORMANCE: Sur gros domaines, cette commande prend du temps (requêtes à distance). Optimisation: limitez avec -SearchBase à une OU. Nécessite: WinRM activé, droits admin sur machines cibles. Offline/Error: PC éteints, WinRM désactivé, firewall bloqué. COMPLIANCE: 100% protection temps réel obligatoire!
